description:
On this 3 hour program at Nine Mile Pond, you will be guided by park rangers through the sawgrass and mangroves. You will get opportunities to experience the Everglades wilderness and its diverse habitats, animals, human history, and the vital water of the “river of grass”.

This trip can be very strenuous! Please consider your abilities and only sign up if you are physically fit and have prior canoeing experience.
what_is_included: All paddling equipment will be provided. Canoes are metal, heavy, and long. We require two people per canoe. We provide life jackets, which everyone is required to wear, and paddles.
itinerary:
* Meet Park Rangers at Nine Mile Pond, located off Main Park Road, about 25 miles away from the park’s Homestead entrance. This will take about 45 minutes from the entrance gate or 25 minutes from Flamingo.
* Advance reservations are required.
* Please arrive 30 minutes prior to the program start time to check-in (8 am).
* 8 people maximum (4 two-person canoes). You must share a two-person canoe with a member of your own party. No single person or odd number party bookings are allowed.
check_in_details:
You will check-in with a park ranger at Nine Mile Pond, about 25 miles past the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center. Allow up to 45 minutes for this drive. Follow signs for Nine Mile Pond. 

Please arrive at least 30 minutes early to check-in (arrive by 8 am). If you are late, we reserve the right to give another visitor your place.

Adults over the age of 18 must complete and submit their own waiver. Minors ages 17 and younger must have a parent or legal guardian sign a waiver on behalf of the minor. All minors must have an adult in the canoe with them.
what_to_bring:
* All paddlers are required to bring plenty of water and closed-toe shoes with good tread.
* We also recommend bringing the following:
    - Sunscreen
    - Hat
    - Sunglasses
    - Bug spray or bug jacket
    - Snacks
    - Paddling gloves
    - Breathable long pants and long-sleeve shirt
    - Binoculars
special_requirements:
* For the safety of all guests, we require that all paddlers are 12 years and older. Minors who are not paddling must weigh at least 50lbs (23 kg). Boats are limited to two people (ages 12+) and one child (50-90 lbs).
* We require that you have prior paddling experience on this moderately strenuous trip. You will be paddling for the full three hours with very few stops. Paddling in Everglades National Park can be a strenuous activity; when water levels are low, paddling can require more strength and stamina. You must be able to paddle the whole trip. Before the trip begins, we will require that you demonstrate paddling proficiency.
* Our canoes require two paddlers to safely maneuver along the route. Only even-numbered bookings are allowed.
* All minors must be accompanied by an adult in their canoes.
* The canoes are metal with no back support.
* You may be asked to assist us in lifting and/or moving the canoes.
* To best accommodate you and make your trip safe and enjoyable, please notify park rangers when checking-in if:
    - You have had any recent surgeries
    - You have any back injuries
    - You have any medical conditions or allergies
    - You are pregnant
    - You have other concerns regarding your safety or health
